versions.short: The bill would extend and amend the federal program that supports Regional Ocean Partnerships, which are groups that coordinate ocean and coastal planning among federal, state, and local partners. It would make several technical wording changes to the existing law, adjust the geographic references in the program, and extend the program's funding through fiscal years 2026 through 2031 with specified annual amounts for 2028 through 2031. It would also require reports to be submitted every five years after enactment, and would bar program funds from being used to develop regulatory proposals, model regulations, or compliance programs.
